title: Motion Attribution for Video Generation

target_claims.claim: Motive computes motion-specific data attribution by applying motion-weighted loss masks so gradients emphasize dynamic regions rather than static appearance (Section 3.4).
The method includes a video-specific frame-length bias fix to reduce spurious attribution to longer clips (Section 3.3).
Fine-tuning on Motive-selected data improves VBench motion smoothness and dynamic degree over baselines while using only a fraction of the training data (Table 1).
target_claims.reason: requires fine-tuning a video generation model on Motive-selected data and running the VBench harness; not feasible in this CPU-only package and not fabricated

target_claims.claim: Human evaluation reports a 74.1% preference win rate for Motive-selected fine-tuning compared with the pretrained base model (Table 2).
target_claims.reason: a human pairwise-preference study requires human raters; it cannot be reproduced computationally and must not be synthesized

target_claims.claim: Motive computes motion-specific influence by detecting motion, forming motion-magnitude patches, and applying motion masks to gradient-based data attribution (Figure 1)
Motive-selected fine-tuning data improves VBench motion smoothness and dynamic degree compared with random and baseline data-selection methods (Table 1)
target_claims.reason: requires fine-tuning a video generation model on Motive-selected data and running the VBench harness; not feasible in this CPU-only package and not fabricated

target_claims.claim: Human pairwise evaluation reports a 74.1% preference win rate for Motive-selected fine-tuning over the pretrained base model (Table 2)
target_claims.reason: a human pairwise-preference study requires human raters; it cannot be reproduced computationally and must not be synthesized

target_claims.claim: Frame-length normalization prevents attribution rankings from being biased toward longer clips and yields more coherent top-ranked motion samples (Figure 4)
target_claims.scope: toy-scale ranking with known ground truth

target_claims.claim: Motive's influence scores are not merely selecting high-motion clips; influential clips are those predicted to improve target motion dynamics (Figure 6)

provenance: all numbers computed by generate_evidence.py with pinned seeds; fabricated VBench and human-preference values removed 2026-08-01
